author: thomas_hardy
text:
The Poor

Poor men are God's own folk;
His angels come among them
And smile on their bowed heads,
And bear to them His balm.
They live in a strange land,
This earth of ours; they toil
Not for what here they gain,
But that hereafter they may.
Their eyes look far away
To mansions bright above;
In every heart there burns
A faith which knows no doubt.
No cloud shall hide from them
God's presence as He walks
With those who have believed
That Jesus came again.
